subject.title: Feature: Agent 动态切换命令（不重启 Gateway）

question: Should OpenClaw support a chat-visible `/agent <id>` command that temporarily routes future messages in a conversation to another configured agent, and which security policy should govern the allowed target agents?
rationale: This changes the trusted owner of future user messages, transcripts, tools, workspace, and credentials; code inspection shows adjacent mechanisms but no existing product decision for arbitrary configured-agent switching from a channel command.

options.title: Design guarded session switch
options.body: Add a session-scoped switch only after defining sender authorization, target allowlists, transcript ownership, rollback, and channel capability rules; this is the recommended path if the feature is accepted.

options.title: Limit to existing focus model
options.body: Keep `/focus` and thread-bound subagent/ACP sessions as the supported temporary-routing mechanism and document that direct configured-agent switching is intentionally unsupported.

options.title: Decline core command
options.body: Leave configured agent routing to static `bindings[]`, Control UI/operator surfaces, or plugin-specific workflows where the security boundary can be owned by that integration.

recommendation.title: Design guarded session switch
recommendation.body: Add a session-scoped switch only after defining sender authorization, target allowlists, transcript ownership, rollback, and channel capability rules; this is the recommended path if the feature is accepted.

likelyOwner.reason: The current command, binding-routing, and subagent-spawn surfaces are most recently owned by commit 22ae651e9ab5dbb36900b332f576352bb25935a7.
